problems.problem: The halo plate no longer frames the hero: disc bottom y=1172 versus product base y=1311 leaves the entire royal-blue ruffle hem band (~139px, plus the ~140px mauve margin below it) hanging outside the pearl ground, so the gown visually exits the plate at its heaviest, most saturated mass. Visible evidence in image 1: the aqua ruffles read on pearl from neckline (y=418, now inside disc top y=372 - the previous fix landed correctly) down to y~1172, then the cobalt hem sits on raw mauve with no graphic anchor, inverting the intended halo-behind-the-garment read at the silhouette's widest point. Extending the plate vertically (taller ellipse, same center_x) or lowering its center would carry the ground through the hem and close the silhouette.

The lockup is still two disconnected islands rather than one designed unit: subtitle bottom y=226 to disc top y=372 leaves a 146px dead band of unmodulated mauve, and the subtitle 'Dress' at size 36 measures only ~113px wide (bbox 493-606) against the 519px title, so the second tier reads as a stray tag. Visible evidence: in image 1 the eye drops from the type block through empty field before finding the plate; references (Claudie's wordmark locked across the subject mass, MaxMara's type anchored into the figure) tie type to subject. Raising the subtitle into the 40-44 range and tightening the gap (subtitle y ~210-215 plus disc top raised toward y~330) would knit the lockup to the plate without breaking the 'above' layout relation.

Against the benchmarks the composition still reads as stacked zones (type band / empty band / plate band / hem band) instead of one continuous field: Claudie and MaxMara both let the subject and type share the same spatial event, while here the cobalt rule at y749-758 is the only element crossing zones and it terminates in open mauve at x84 and x996 without relating to the type block above. Visible evidence: the rule's overhang reads decisive mid-frame but nothing echoes it in the top band, so the poster's four horizontal strata never interact; a single tying device (rule weight echoed as a thin keyline under the subtitle, or plate lifted to meet the type band) would close the gap to reference-level integration.
